snippet.title: Amicusia 2.0.0 Map Changes
snippet.description: I promise to start uploading these more regularly, at lease once a month. This just shows off the changes to the map and that I added a monster to fight.  the next update will be on April first, it will include the ability to kill these guys and sell their drops for money which you can use to buy food, a place to sleep, or "gamble" in one of the many games. This is probably as bad as the game will ever look so stay tuned!
